_comment: Trigger scenarios: which skill should load for a prompt, and which tool should be called first. expected_skill null means no skill in this plugin should fire. scripts/validate.mjs checks the names; run the prompts by hand (or with your eval harness of choice) before a release.

scenarios.prompt: How is my community doing this month?
Give me a weekly recap of what happened in the community
Schedule a community AMA next Thursday at 11am PT with Priya as host
Add our October webinar to the community calendar and announce it in #announcements
Set up an onboarding journey so new members get a badge after their first post
I want a new-member checklist with milestones and a reward
Connect Claude to my Tightknit community
The Tightknit tools say unauthorized, what do I do?
Archive the #random feed on our community site
Which members completed the getting-started journey?
Delete the test event I made yesterday
Build me a Slack app with Bolt for Python
Summarize the last 20 messages in our Slack #engineering channel
